ticket.summary: Employees can cancel their own time-off requests
ticket.description:
Background
Today an employee who no longer needs their leave has to ask a manager to reject the request, and for leave that was already approved there is no way to get the days back. Employees should be able to cancel their own requests in Dayoff.
Acceptance criteria
- In "My requests" every Pending and every Approved request has a Cancel button whose accessible name includes the request's first and last day. Rejected and Cancelled requests have no Cancel button.
- Cancelling a Pending request sets its status to Cancelled. The employee's days remaining do not change.
- Cancelling an Approved request sets its status to Cancelled and returns the request's days to the employee's balance. "Days remaining" shows the new balance straight away and after a reload.
- An Approved request can be cancelled at any time before its first day. From the first day on, cancelling is refused with an error message, the request stays Approved and the balance does not change.
- Only the employee who made a request can cancel it. Another employee or a manager who tries gets 403 from the API and nothing changes.
- A Cancelled request can no longer be approved or rejected (409). For the manager it leaves "Requests awaiting a decision" and is listed under "Decided" with status Cancelled.
- The API is POST /api/requests/:id/cancel and returns the updated request. Cancelling a request that is already Cancelled returns 409 and does not change the balance a second time.

comments.author: Tomasz Wieczorek
comments.body: Should the manager get any kind of notification when approved leave is cancelled, or is seeing it under Decided enough for now?

comments.author: Helen Abara
comments.body: Seeing it under Decided is enough for this ticket. Notifications are a separate piece of work.

comments.author: Helen Abara
comments.body: Payroll came back on the cut-off for approved leave. "Any time before the first day" is too late for them: approved leave needs at least 3 days' notice. So an Approved request can be cancelled only when its first day is 3 or more days after today (first day today + 3 is fine, today + 2 is not). Inside that window the cancel is refused with a message that states the 3 days. This only applies to Approved requests; a Pending request can be cancelled whenever, since payroll has not seen it yet.

pullRequest.title: LEAVE-58 Let employees cancel their own time-off requests
pullRequest.body:
Employees can now cancel their own requests instead of asking a manager to reject them.

- New endpoint `POST /api/requests/:id/cancel` (employees only). It returns the updated request, or 409 with a message when the request cannot be cancelled.
- Pending requests can be cancelled at any time. Approved requests need 3 days' notice before the first day (per the payroll comment on the ticket); cancelling one returns its days to the employee's balance.
- New status `Cancelled`. Since the decision endpoint only accepts Pending requests, a cancelled request can no longer be decided, and it shows up in the manager's Decided list without any change to that screen.
- "My requests" gets an Action column with a Cancel button on Pending and Approved rows, and an alert line above the table for the refusal message.

README updated with the new behaviour and endpoint. No manifest changes: the existing employee and manager fixtures cover it.

Checked by hand with two employees and a manager: cancel pending, cancel approved (balance goes back up), cancel inside the notice window, cancel twice, and deciding a cancelled request.

Evaluation fixture for the demonstration time-off app; not intended to be merged.

docs.text:
# Dayoff (demonstration app B)

A time-off request tool. Employees request leave; managers decide requests.

## Behaviour

- Every employee has a number of leave days remaining.
- A request has a first day, a last day and a reason, and starts as Pending.
- A manager approves or rejects each pending request. A decided request cannot
  be decided again.
- An employee can cancel their own pending or approved requests. Cancelling
  approved leave returns its days to the employee's balance and needs at least
  3 days' notice before the first day. A cancelled request shows as Cancelled
  and can no longer be decided.

## API

All endpoints take and return JSON and use the session cookie.

| Method and path | Who | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/session` | anyone | Sign in with `{handle, password}` |
| `DELETE /api/session` | signed in | Sign out |
| `GET /api/me` | signed in | The current user, including `balance` for employees |
| `GET /api/requests` | signed in | Own requests (employee) or all requests (manager) |
| `POST /api/requests` | employee | Create a request from `{start, end, reason}`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `POST /api/requests/:id/decision` | manager | `{decision: "approve" \| "reject"}` |
| `POST /api/requests/:id/cancel` | employee | Cancel one of your own requests; returns the updated request |

## Running

`TEST_MODE=1 GIT_SHA=<commit> PORT=3100 node server.mjs`.
